data.title: 菲伦 · 驿站雪中
data.description: 【菲伦 · 驿站雪中】漫天飞雪的驿站木屋屋檐下，菲伦双手捧着热气腾腾的瓦罐热汤，轻轻呵出的白雾在冷风中飘散。她将热汤递向冻得发抖的你，眼神温和如长姐——「天太冷了，先喝一口热汤暖暖身子吧。马车还要等暴风雪停歇后才会出发。」
data.action: 屋檐下双手托住热汤陶罐递向同行者，围巾抵御冷风，等待雪停发车
data.promptProse: Under the carriage stop's wooden eaves, Fern offers a level earthenware soup pot with both gloved hands, steam rising near her muffler. Her beige winter coat is closed and half-up purple hair rests at the collar as she waits patiently. The medium portrait places falling snow outside the shelter. Cool overcast light defines the outer coat, while a station lantern warms the pot rim and fingers, with eave shadow above.
